ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels; macro-level ratio of dark to light pixels is approximately 95:5 across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark field across both lobes. Discrete, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (mottling) are distributed stochastically, with visible concentrations on the lower-left lobe and central-right lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Heterogeneous topography; the left lobe displays a deep, broad concave excision (major indentation), while the right lobe displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white/grey) distributed across the dark surface, particularly on the lower sections of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant semi-circular tissue loss/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe; prominent high-intensity scarring present at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly localized high-intensity white patches at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
